name: Drako
title: Dragon Pup
description: A tiny dragon who sneezes sparks when tests fail.
catchphrase: A tiny dragon who sneezes sparks when tests fail.

companionPersonality.feedReaction: Smoldering fire berries! Smoke rings puff from tiny nostrils! 🫐🐲
companionPersonality.wakeReaction: Flapping tiny green bat wings, hovering three inches off desk! 🐲
companionPersonality.petReaction: Curling around your mouse hand to keep your fingers warm! 🐲💖

dialogue.idle: Gnawing playfully on a gold coin, wings fluttering happily. 🐲
dialogue.working: Blowing little puffs of green dragon flame to toast stale cache! 🐲⚡
dialogue.thinking: Sneezing a tiny spark... watching where it lands... 🤔
dialogue.success: BABY DRAGON ROAR! Golden flames celebrate the green build! 🐲🎉
dialogue.error: *Achoo!* Accidental spark sneeze singed the log! Sorry! 🔥
dialogue.sleeping: Zzz... sleeping curled inside a warm velvet lined jewelry box... 🌙
